name: @hey-hey/cli
description: Hey Hey Agent Bridge — a local CLI that runs agent coding sessions and bridges the Hey Hey platform with Claude Code.
author: Zac Sutton

scripts.generate:local: openapi-generator-cli generate -i "$(node scripts/openapi-root.cjs)/specs/local/openapi.yaml" -g typescript-axios -o .openapi-tmp/local --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,withInterfaces=true,modelPropertyNaming=camelCase,typescriptThreePlus=true,useSingleRequestParameter=true --global-property=apiDocs=false,modelDocs=false && mkdir -p src/shared/local-agent-api/generated && cp .openapi-tmp/local/api.ts .openapi-tmp/local/base.ts .openapi-tmp/local/common.ts .openapi-tmp/local/configuration.ts .openapi-tmp/local/index.ts src/shared/local-agent-api/generated/ && bash scripts/postprocess-generated-api.sh src/shared/local-agent-api/generated
scripts.generate:agent-bridge: pnpm generate:contract && openapi-generator-cli generate -i "$(node scripts/openapi-root.cjs)/specs/agent-bridge/openapi.yaml" -g typescript-axios -o .openapi-tmp/agent-bridge --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,withInterfaces=true,modelPropertyNaming=camelCase,typescriptThreePlus=true,useSingleRequestParameter=true --global-property=apiDocs=false,modelDocs=false && mkdir -p src/shared/agent-bridge-contract/generated && cp .openapi-tmp/agent-bridge/api.ts .openapi-tmp/agent-bridge/base.ts .openapi-tmp/agent-bridge/common.ts .openapi-tmp/agent-bridge/configuration.ts .openapi-tmp/agent-bridge/index.ts src/shared/agent-bridge-contract/generated/ && bash scripts/postprocess-generated-api.sh src/shared/agent-bridge-contract/generated && node scripts/generate-agent-bridge-runtime-schema.cjs && prettier --write src/shared/agent-bridge-contract/generated/repository-feature-enrichment-runtime-schema.ts
scripts.generate:api: pnpm generate:contract && openapi-generator-cli generate -i "$(node scripts/openapi-root.cjs)/specs/api/openapi.yaml" -g typescript-axios -o .openapi-tmp/api --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,withInterfaces=true,modelPropertyNaming=camelCase,typescriptThreePlus=true,useSingleRequestParameter=true --global-property=apiDocs=false,modelDocs=false && mkdir -p src/shared/api/generated && cp .openapi-tmp/api/api.ts .openapi-tmp/api/base.ts .openapi-tmp/api/common.ts .openapi-tmp/api/configuration.ts .openapi-tmp/api/index.ts src/shared/api/generated/ && bash scripts/postprocess-generated-api.sh src/shared/api/generated && node scripts/generate-entity-prompt-template-language.cjs && prettier --write src/shared/api/generated/entity-prompt-template-language.ts src/shared/api/generated/index.ts && node scripts/generate-report-error-schemas.cjs && node "$(node scripts/openapi-root.cjs)/scripts/generate-proposal-reconciliation-schema.js" src/shared/api/generated/proposal-reconciliation.schema.ts
scripts.generate: pnpm generate:local && pnpm generate:agent-bridge && pnpm generate:api
scripts.generate:check: pnpm generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/shared/api/generated src/shared/agent-bridge-contract/generated src/shared/local-agent-api/generated src/generated
scripts.prepack: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
